_comment: MSV3 fleet registry. Binds each probe's sensor ID to the BLE addresses it is allowed to
appear on and to the bootloader currently installed on it.
Why this file exists: SENSOR_ID is a hand-edited constant in MSV3_Moisture_BLE_Sleep.ino, and
scripts/ble_ota_update.py targets a raw BLE address. Nothing previously connected the two, so
an image built for one probe could be sent to another -- giving two probes the same sensor ID
and silently mixing two plants' data in the receiver. The flasher now resolves --probe N
through this file and refuses any address or package identity that disagrees with it.
application_address is the address the running application advertises on. recovery_address is
application_address + 1, which is where the bootloader advertises when it starts with NO valid
application. After a successful buttonless jump the bootloader instead reuses
application_address, because the peer-data handoff carries it across the reset -- so BOTH
addresses are legitimate bootloader locations and the flasher accepts either.
device_type is the two-byte DFU target tag the installed bootloader accepts: 0x0052 is
Adafruit's stock constant, 0x3356 is what MSV3's own bootloader build replaces it with. It
stops stock-packaged images installing; it is NOT a security property and NOT model-specific.
legacy_package_sha256 allowlists specific pre-65538 application images for one probe. Below
that version the advertised name is not provably equal to the compiled SENSOR_ID, so on a
deployed probe --allow-legacy-package alone is refused; only an image hashed here gets
through. Add one only when deployment records establish that exact image. Empty is correct
when you have no such record -- rebuild instead.
bootloader_key_sha256 pins the SHA-256 of the 64-byte P-256 public point (Qx||Qy) that the
probe's installed bootloader was built to trust. ble_ota_update.py checks the release
manifest's key against it before verifying a signature, so changing the client's trust root
takes a visible edit here as well as to the manifest. 1.0.0 and 1.0.1 share one trust root.
deployed=true means the probe is expected to be advertising, so msv3_fleet_scan.py treats
its absence as a problem. The bench board is deployed=false: it sits powered off most of the
time and its silence says nothing.
'observed' fields record a real scan or transfer, 'inferred' fields have not been seen yet.

installed_application_version is bookkeeping: the bootloader cannot report what it is running. Stock and MSV3 1.0.1 do not enforce it; MSV3 1.0.2+ also records and enforces an on-device anti-rollback floor. ble_ota_update.py independently refuses a package below this value unless --allow-downgrade. Update it after every successful transfer. 0 disables the host-side check.

swd_accessible is MUTABLE PHYSICAL STATE, not history: are this probe's SWD/USB pads reachable RIGHT NOW? Conformal coating makes it false. SET IT FALSE THE MOMENT A PROBE IS COATED -- arduino_msv3_probe.ps1 refuses to build a deliberately-hanging -HangTest image for any probe where this is false, and that refusal is the only thing standing between a coated probe and an image that never opens a radio window.

guard2_validated is a DURABLE FACT and deliberately separate: this hardware has actually demonstrated the watchdog-loop -> BLE DFU escape. Having passed the test once does not make a coated probe recoverable today, so nothing gates on this field; it records what has been proven so a future session does not have to guess.

probes.name: MSV3-MOISTURE-004
probes.notes: The water-immersion board. Migrated off the stock bootloader 2026-09-03 and updated over BLE alone. In soil, battery + solar. Running build 2026-09-05-guard1 (guard 1 only; ENABLE_BOOT_FAILURE_GUARD is staged off until the watchdog-hang test runs with SWD). Confirmed 2026-09-05 00:55 PDT: -72 dBm, 3983 mV, flags 0x1c, DIS reports the build over BLE, receiver ingesting with no false faults. PROVENANCE GAP, recorded 2026-09-05: the exact package installed on this probe was never archived -- it was built into the gitignored .arduino-build/ path, which later builds overwrote, and its source carried an uncommitted SENSOR_ID edit that no commit describes. The running image therefore cannot be reproduced byte-for-byte from this repository. Since 2026-09-05 identity is a build parameter (arduino_msv3_probe.ps1 -SensorId), so (commit, sensor id, build tag) reproduces an image exactly and this cannot recur. Rebuild an equivalent with -SensorId 4 before the next OTA to this probe, and archive the package. This is the battery-powered production unit; final provisioning and coating remain deferred until probes 6 and 7 have exercised the conformal-coating process and functional Probe 6 passes its post-cure check.

probes.name: MSV3-MOISTURE-005
probes.notes: Bootloader 1.0.3 installed over SWD on 2026-09-08. Signed application v65555 (MSV3-BUILD:2026-09-08-prod5; Guard 1 and Guard 2 on; serial logs off) installed over BLE from recovery address F9:18:9B:CA:10:B3 in 28 s. DIS read back the exact build ID. A 150-second scan observed 29 packets across two advancing wakes (+1), valid sensor data, 4411 mV, flags 0x1c, and an open OTA gate. The 4411 mV observation was while USB-powered with no battery attached, so it is not a cell-voltage measurement. Equality-version rescue package SHA-256: 0198dd469cbc2ba411b73f310c5d0054e84abe9a5bd7c0dc1db60faf46ddf735.

probes.name: MSV3-MOISTURE-006
probes.recovery_address_source: observed 2026-09-08 after first SWD provisioning of the raw board
probes.notes: Raw board provisioned with bootloader 1.0.3 over SWD on 2026-09-08; all five segments read-back verified. Signed application v65556 (MSV3-BUILD:2026-09-08-prod6; Guard 1 and Guard 2 on; serial logs off) installed over BLE from recovery address D8:2B:71:CB:90:B1 in 26 s. DIS read back the exact build ID. A 150-second scan observed 31 packets across two advancing wakes (+1), valid sensor data, USB power, flags 0x1c, and an open OTA gate. Equality-version rescue package SHA-256: adfa0910a26874906aed5611c1308c2805c69205cbd319f5fe15620df68d408d. Final SWD settings-page readback passed: magic 0x4D535633, rollback floor 65556, complement 0xFFFEFFEB. Designated as the functional first conformal-coating trial. Conformal-coated by 2026-09-12; SWD pads are no longer accessible, while USB remains available for the diagnostic console. Verify air baseline, sensor/reference behavior, and BLE again after full cure before coating production Probe 4.
probes.diagnostic_state: 2026-09-13 post-coating check: signed bring-up diagnostic v65561 (MSV3-BUILD:2026-09-13-coated6-diag) installed application-only over BLE; resident bootloader 1.0.3 preserved. USB console observation was approximately 20,000,000 DATA_CH0 in the untouched condition and approximately 19,000,000 with two-hand contact, a roughly 1,000,000-count / 5% decrease. This proves a substantial qualitative response survived coating; it is not yet an air/soil/watering calibration or a recorded connected-to-bare/phase acceptance result. Signed production restore v65562 (MSV3-BUILD:2026-09-13-prod6-restore) was built and preflighted before installing diagnostics.

probes.name: MSV3-MOISTURE-007
probes.recovery_address_source: observed 2026-09-08 after first SWD provisioning of the raw board
probes.notes: NOT DEPLOYMENT-READY; SENSOR PATH EFFECTIVELY BRICKED: post-commissioning telemetry on 2026-09-08 exposed a TMUX1109 path fault. Phase 0 connected/bare counts were 19,502,047/19,502,915 and phase 1 counts were 20,784,705/20,784,074: the supposed bare reading mirrors connected within 0.005% in both phases, while phases 0/1 disagree by 1,282,658 counts (about 6.37%). MUX1/A1 (E73 P0.31 to TMUX1109 pin 16) therefore has no observable effect, and the phase disagreement repeatedly trips the large-swing advertising path, creating the 32k/45k dashboard alternation. The MCU, BLE, OTA, and bootloader are healthy. No replacement TMUX will be ordered. Future salvage plan: power off, remove the TMUX1109, then bridge TANK_HOT to MS_NODE_A and TANK_REF to MS_NODE_B; never add these bridges while the mux remains populated. A bypass-specific application must fix one phase and mark the bare reference invalid. Probe 7 may be a sacrificial conformal-coating process test, but cannot validate post-coat moisture sensing and coating before repair will obstruct mux removal/bridging. Raw board was provisioned with bootloader 1.0.3 over SWD on 2026-09-08; all five segments read-back verified. Signed application v65556 (MSV3-BUILD:2026-09-08-prod7; Guard 1 and Guard 2 on; serial logs off) installed over BLE from recovery address F7:B1:E6:50:EC:B7 in 29 s. DIS read back the exact build ID. Equality-version rescue package SHA-256: e40c8f0b712a9f72d322f14a512d4ef2484e76929c5bdd34457beeb617ec6c6f. Final SWD settings-page readback passed: magic 0x4D535633, rollback floor 65556, complement 0xFFFEFFEB.

probes.name: MSV3-MOISTURE-008
probes.recovery_address_source: observed repeatedly through the 2026-09-02/03 bootloader work
probes.notes: Former USB/SWD-recoverable bench probe 99, reassigned as production identity 8 on 2026-09-08. Bootloader 1.0.3 was installed over SWD after a verified mass erase and previously passed the Guard-2 watchdog-loop/recovery test as probe 99. Signed application v65557 (MSV3-BUILD:2026-09-08-prod8; Guard 1 and Guard 2 on; serial logs off) installed over BLE in 36 s, and DIS read back the exact build ID. A 150-second scan observed 28 packets across two advancing scheduled advertisements (+1), valid sensor data, USB power, flags 0x1c, and an open OTA gate. Phase-0 connected DATA_CH0 was 20,424,754 versus bare 22,664,597, a healthy 10.97% separation; no Probe-7-like off-cadence alternating swings appeared, bounding gross phase asymmetry below the firmware's 300,000-count swing trigger during the scan. Equality-version rescue package SHA-256: 9c6955c104fe544c15f11ea24c52f08d01201431e88ff0764c5512815a8bacf5. Final settings-page SWD readback remains pending.
